title: Zero fan-out beyond the circuit
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $G$ be a finite acyclic list of gates on $n$ input vertices, with each gate reading only vertices preceding it. If $n+|G|\le v$, then no gate in $G$ reads vertex $v$; equivalently, the fan-out of $v$ within $G$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is acyclic relative to $n$ input vertices
